entities.summary: Southern England, also known as the South of England or the South, is the southern part of England, covering the statistical regions of London, the South East, the South West and the East. It is bordered by the Midlands to the north, while it also shares a border with Wales to its far north-west. Altogether, it forms a population of nearly 28 million and an area of 23,955 square miles (62,042 km2).
